question: In the Sasageru IF, Petra's name was hidden behind ■ the whole time, but I think there was one line where only "Pe" (ペ) was visible. Why was only "Pe" visible there, and is there a possibility that "to" (ト) and "ra" (ラ) will become visible later?
answer:
The representation with ■ expresses being forgotten by the world, but it also expresses Subaru struggling to remember, "trying to say it but unable to say it."

The reason "Pe" became visible was to express a nuance that while searching for a loophole in the condition offered by the Witch of Melancholy, he might eventually be able to call her name, and if it's Subaru, he might find a way.

Someday the remaining ■ might peel away, and if Subaru achieves it once, others might be able to call her name too. Though that is under the condition that the method isn't sacrificed as a cost again.
